title: Grilled Vegetable Skewers with Chimichurri
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian skewer dish that combines the taste of grilled vegetables with the tanginess of Argentinean-style chimichurri sauce.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together red wine vinegar, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper for the chimichurri sauce.
3. Thread lamb's lettuce, red bell pepper, zucchini, red onion, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes onto skewers.
4. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
5. Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
6. Serve the grilled skewers with the chimichurri sauce on the side.
